references.text: Esau ran to meet him, embraced him, fell on his neck and kissed him. And they wept.
See how good and how delightful it is for brothers also to dwell together!
They all began to weep aloud, and they threw their arms around Paul's neck and kissed him.
Strong thematic parallel: Kissing combined with sudden weeping at an intense family farewell or reunion.
Theological parallel: The active, running reunion that shows unconditional grace toward a lost brother/son.
Character parallel: Joseph's expression of deep love and sorrow through weeping and kissing toward his family (father vs. brothers).
Thematic parallel: Deep fraternal love expressed through shared weeping and kissing at a painful farewell.
